scope: 2026-10-17 unified restyle of care props: shared four-step palette, 1/16-grid low-poly meshes, no black outlines; shop goods are cream ceramic, mint plastic, strawberry fabric and kraft paper, wild items are leaves, twigs, straw, cardboard and soil. User-confirmed leaf bed, twig barrier and house eggs are untouched.

vanilla_texture_references.note: Parts of these meshes name vanilla textures instead of carrying pixels; they resolve to the player's Minecraft resources at runtime and are not stored in the repository.

forest_burrow/personal_leaf_nest/bedding: block/oak_leaves, birch_leaves, spruce_leaves (tinted), short_grass, moss_block, podzol_top, coarse_dirt, oak_log, spruce_log, hay_block_top, item/wheat

models.food_bowl: standards/yukkuri-library/drafts/block-props/devices.py (six dye styles, fills food_bowl_regular/_wheat/_forage as stepped heaps per portion)
models.yukkuri_carrier: standards/yukkuri-library/drafts/block-props/devices.py (yukkuri_carrier_fine and yukkuri_carrier_large are their own meshes; the large one is wider and taller)
models.pet_beds: standards/yukkuri-library/drafts/block-props/nests.py: straw_nest, yukkuri_nest and its six styles, velvet_nest, pet_nest_fit_1..15 on one shared atlas layout (kit.share_atlas); grade parts the lower grades cut out (kit solid=False)
models.predator_nest: standards/yukkuri-library/drafts/block-props/nests.py, exported by art/props/predators/build.py (own atlas, no vanilla textures)
models.teaching_whistle, wash_cloth, companion_: extruded inventory icons (cloth and cord laid flat), exported by standards/yukkuri-library/drafts/care-expansion/build.py
models.ceramic_tunnel/yukkuri_slide/yukkuri_tra: standards/yukkuri-library/drafts/playgrounds/build.py (collision from the same cells, slide chute sampled along its slope; trampoline bed is unit 2 with its pivot at y 8), in-use preview standards/yukkuri-library/drafts/playgrounds/preview.py

block_style.style: vanilla-like: axis-aligned voxel cuboids on the 1/16 grid at one texel per unit, icon ramps lit from the top left, each rounded object an explicit stepped-round recipe (octagon/inset vessels, stepped sphere) with painted detail; small handheld or dropped items are their 16x16 icon extruded like item/generated with vanilla hand angles and a 30-degree fixed view
block_style.status: arbiter R0: food_bowl, yarn_ball and mold_remover accepted; package 1 (devices and nests) awaiting the arbiter and user playtest

material_tiles: kit.py material tiles: palette colours drawn as 16x16 texel tiles with sparse one-step pixel noise, world-aligned at 1 texel per unit (vanilla density), for the low-poly care props; the placed pet goods are block_style; wild self-built nests are wild.py

placed_goods.author: standards/yukkuri-library/drafts/block-props/devices.py, nests.py (block_style)
placed_goods.style: block style (block_style.style); several dye-selected styles per item on the same geometry; fills are heap-only meshes drawn inside any bowl style; footprints and contact heights are unchanged; the pet beds and the 2x2 woven nest keep the collision envelope generated from the earlier rounded beds (placed.py), which the block-style tops follow within a unit
placed_goods.styles_table: life/CareStyles.java (dye -> style) mirrors vanilla_props.STYLES; non-default styles ship as runtime-peripheral attachments named <block id>_<style>
placed_goods.runtime_hook: client/CareRenderer draws <model>[_<style>] from CareBlockEntity Pattern, then the fill mesh for bowls, and the stored droppings on the sand toilet floor
placed_goods.collision: src/main/resources/assets/mcyukkuri/yukkuri_presentation/care_collision.json (placed.collision(): the rounded envelope of the pet bed per fitted mask and of the 2x2 woven nest, written by build.py; life/CareBlock builds the pet bed and large_yukkuri_nest collision and selection height from it)
